cues.zh: 我为你们引见雷戈维亚神圣选定的统治者。
cues.en: I present to you the divinely chosen ruler of Regovia.
♪ They all got in the way ♪
♪ Of this life that we could ♪

cues.zh: 真不敢相信父亲竟让我们自己打猎觅食。
cues.en: I can't believe Father is making us hunt for our own food.

cues.zh: 父亲带我们来这里，是要给我们上宝贵的一课。
cues.en: Father brought us here to teach us a valuable lesson.
Today, you must embark on a hunt.

cues.zh: 要成长为这片疆域的统治者，你们也得参与其中，学会这门本事。
cues.en: To develop as rulers of this realm, you, too, must participate and learn the craft.
(Young Jules) Shouldn't be too hard, right?
Not so hard, is it Jules?
(Young Philip) Ugh, How much farther are we going to have to walk?

cues.zh: 算了吧，Jules。其余的野兔都跑了。
cues.en: Just give it up, Jules. The rest of the hares ran away.
I'm sure there's one around here somewhere.
(Young Philip) Afraid you'll let down Father?

cues.zh: 我们该回去了，不然会被黑暗吞没。
cues.en: We should head back or the darkness will swallow us.
hah, You were correct after all!

cues.zh: 现在我有两只，你一只也没有。
cues.en: Now I've got two and you have none.

cues.zh: 求你了，给我一只吧，就一只，让我带回去交差。
cues.en: Please, give me one, just to carry back.

cues.zh: 我必须让父亲看到，我和哥哥一样有能力统治。
cues.en: I must show Father that I'm as capable to rule as my brother.

cues.zh: 我不敢两手空空、只带着耻辱回去见父亲。
cues.en: I don't dare to return to father with only shame carried in my hands.

cues.zh: 你还记得父亲教我们的神圣对决吗？
cues.en: Do you remember what Father taught us about holy combat?

cues.zh: 你是说国王们玩的游戏？
cues.en: You mean the game kings play?

cues.zh: 以兔子为注，以父亲的祝福为注，
cues.en: For the hare, for Father's blessing,

cues.zh: 我向你挑战——石头剪刀布！
cues.en: I challenge you to Rock, Paper, Crossblades!

cues.zh: 如果同等身份的人向你挑战，你必须接受。
cues.en: If a person of the same status challenges you, you must accept.

cues.zh: 唉，我的灵魂换一只野兔。
cues.en: Gah, My soul for a single hare.

cues.zh: 可他当然知道你能下这么高的赌注。
cues.en: But of course he knows you can wager so high.

cues.zh: 父亲的评判笼罩着我们。
我知道父亲对我们一视同仁，但随着每一堂课，
cues.en: I know Father loves us equally, but with each passing lesson,

cues.zh: 我总觉得自己离他的恩宠越来越远。
cues.en: I feel myself sinking further from his good graces.

cues.zh: 但在永恒之爱面前，父爱又算得了什么。
cues.en: But what good is fatherly love in the eyes of love, eternal.

cues.zh: 若没有那联结我们的圣灵，我将一文不值，
cues.en: Without the Holy Spirit that binds us, I'll be worthless,

cues.zh: 在被提之时，注定作为一个背教者在荒芜的星球上漂泊。
cues.en: doomed to roam an empty planet as an apostate when rapture strikes.

cues.zh: 仆人们一定在为伟大的猎手们准备盛宴。
cues.en: The servants must be preparing a feast for the great hunters.

cues.zh: 你脸色这么苍白，什么也没吃。
cues.en: You're so pale and haven't eaten a thing.
(King Maximillion) Philip, w-what has happened to your brother?
The young prince has fallen ill!

cues.zh: 在我加冕一周年纪念日的今天，
cues.en: On this day, the one year anniversary of my coronation,

cues.zh: 我献上一件和平的信物。
cues.en: I bring forth, a token of peace.

cues.zh: 正是蛮族国王本人赠予我的。
cues.en: Given to me by none other than the barbarian king himself.

cues.zh: 这件和平信物意味着他们的进攻将就此终止。
cues.en: This token of peace means their attacks will come to an end.

cues.zh: 看看他们，如此自满又快乐。
cues.en: Look at them, so complacent and happy.

cues.zh: 和平。战争。到底有什么区别呢？
cues.en: Peace. War. What's the difference, anyway?

cues.zh: 如今他们已在我掌心之中，
cues.en: Now they're in the palm of my hand,

cues.zh: 随时听候我的每一条命令。
cues.en: ready to obey my every order.

cues.zh: 是我的眼睛在欺骗我吗？
你早知道我会回来夺回属于我的一切。
cues.en: You knew I would return to claim what is rightfully mine.
Gah, The mark on your head!

cues.zh: 我已不再是当年那个假装的善良之人了。
cues.en: I'm no longer the kind soul I once pretended to be.

cues.zh: 我按Crossblades的规矩修炼了整整一年。
cues.en: I've trained for one whole year in the order of the Crossblades.

cues.zh: 你竟敢拒绝神圣决斗的召唤？
cues.en: You dare refuse the call to holy combat?
We are no longer of the same status.

cues.zh: 如今我是国王。而你不是。
cues.en: I am now a king. And you are not.

cues.zh: 我无需接受平民的挑战。
cues.en: I need not accept challenges from peasants.

cues.zh: 不过，尽管去挑战哪个仆人吧。
cues.en: But, by all means, go challenge one of the servants.

cues.zh: 也许他们会陪你玩玩你的妄想。
一年过去，你还是那么懦弱。
cues.en: One year later, and you’re as cowardly as ever.

cues.zh: 真正的国王绝不会拒绝神圣决斗的召唤！
cues.en: No true king rejects the call for holy combat!

cues.zh: 除非挑战我的是真正的国王。
cues.en: Only when a true king challenges me.

cues.zh: 我兄弟偏偏在我加冕周年这天让我丢脸。
cues.en: My brother embarrasses me on the anniversary of my coronation, no less.

cues.zh: Philip，我知道今晚对你很重要，
cues.en: Philip, I know this night was important to you,

cues.zh: 但你也看到了流放把他变成了什么样。
cues.en: but you saw what exile has done to him.

cues.zh: （伊丽莎白女王）他毕竟是你孪生兄弟。
cues.en: (Queen Elizabeth) He's your twin after all.

cues.zh: （伊丽莎白女王）他经历了太多。
cues.en: (Queen Elizabeth) And he's been through a lot.

cues.zh: 你要治理王国，不是了结恩怨。
cues.en: You have a kingdom to rule, not a score to settle.
You keep the gates to my heart open.
The people would suffer without you.

cues.zh: 你太抬举我了，我的爱人。

cues.en: We've had enough revelry for one evening.

cues.zh: 但如今站在这里，我满心疑问。
cues.en: But now that I stand here, I'm filled with questions.

cues.zh: 我从未怀疑过你对我的爱。
cues.en: I have never questioned your love for me.

cues.zh: 但我开始怀疑……我们造物主的爱。
cues.en: But I begin to question the love of...our Creator.
Fate forces my hand to lose every battle.

cues.zh: 自那悔恨之日起，我是否就被诅咒了？
cues.en: Have I been cursed since that rueful day?

cues.zh: 当我少年愚行变成弥天大罪？
cues.en: When my boyish folly turned into cosmic sin?
Have I not proven myself yet?

cues.zh: 如果你真的存在，就指引我吧，我会追随你。
cues.en: If you’re really there, guide me, and I will follow.

cues.zh: 如果我必须成为国王才能挑战他，那就这样吧。
cues.en: If I must be a king to challenge him, then so be it.

cues.zh: 在我戴上属于自己的王冠之前，我不会再见到他。
cues.en: I shall not see him again until I wear a crown of my own.

cues.zh: 我必须找到一个需要国王的王国。
cues.en: I must find a kingdom in need of a king.
have come to avenge my kingdom.
You have forced my subjects into submission.

cues.zh: 你劫掠我的土地，然后把你掠夺的战利品称为和平的象征。
cues.en: You raid my lands and then call your spoils of war a token of peace.

cues.zh: 你带给我人民的唯一和平，是寂静的坟墓。
cues.en: The only peace you brought to my people were quiet graves.

cues.zh: 作为他们的领袖，我有责任亲自与你分享
cues.en: As their leader, it is my duty to personally share
your vision of peace with you.
(Guard) Oi, keep the doors closed tonight.
I am a guest of the King.

cues.zh: 今晚不允许再有客人了。
我不过是一叶孤舟，被放逐出海。
cues.en: I am but a vessel, sent out to sea.

cues.zh: 让命运之风把我带向敌人。
cues.en: Let the winds of fate carry me to my enemy.

cues.zh: 让敌人的欲望，把目光引向那神圣的死亡象征，
cues.en: And let my enemie’s lust bring their gaze upon the holy symbol of death
which I carry by my side.

cues.zh: 那是我的最后一根火柴。

cues.en: Looks like you need a hand.

cues.zh: 伊丽莎白。看着我的眼睛。
cues.en: Elizabeth. Look me in the eye.

cues.zh: 让你的眼睛只看着我，别的什么都别看。
cues.en: Let your eyes gaze upon me and nothing else.

cues.zh: 我的眼睛只看着您，陛下。
cues.en: My eyes gaze upon none but you, my lord.

cues.zh: 对，但此刻你若稍有闪失，
cues.en: Yes, but if you falter for even a moment now,

cues.zh: 你的审判降临了，菲利普国王。
cues.en: Your judgment is upon you, King Philip.

cues.zh: 凝视死亡的象征，带着荣耀赴死吧。
cues.en: Gaze into the symbol of death and die with honor.

cues.zh: 他以为我会中他那点小把戏？
cues.en: Does he think I'll give in to his little trick?

cues.zh: 哈！显然，他从没遇到过像我这样的头脑。
cues.en: Hah! Clearly, he's never faced a mind like mine.

cues.zh: 但伊丽莎白，甜美的伊丽莎白。
她的心和头脑都完全敞开。
cues.en: Her heart and her mind are wide open.

cues.zh: 不然她的笑容怎能如此轻松地令人愉悦，
cues.en: How else could her smile be an effortless delight

cues.zh: 让所有有幸见到她的人都为之倾倒。
cues.en: to all who are graced by her presence.

cues.zh: 但也正像蝴蝶一样，哪怕一阵轻风也能把她吹离航向。
cues.en: But also, much like a butterfly, can be blown off course by even a gentle breeze.

cues.zh: 你古老的学识将你的心智武装得比我见过的任何人都坚固。
cues.en: your ancient knowledge has fortified your mind like no one else I've met.

cues.zh: 你为保护心灵筑起的铁壁或许撑得住。
cues.en: While the iron walls you've built to protect your psyche may hold.

cues.zh: 可现在我看到了一道裂缝，我能从中溜进去。
cues.en: Now I see there is a crack through which I can slip.

cues.zh: 这件珍宝又该属于谁呢？
cues.en: And to whom might this treasure belong?

cues.zh: 希望它不会从我掌心滑落摔碎。
cues.en: I hope it doesn't slip from my palm and break.

cues.zh: 我们有许多神圣的传家宝。

cues.en: And whose ashes might these be?

cues.zh: 希望不是什么重要人物。
你的钢铁意志令人印象深刻。
cues.en: Your iron will is very impressive.

cues.zh: 但告诉我，你的意志够不够强。
cues.en: But tell me, is your will strong enough.

cues.zh: 落在你亲爱的女王身上吧。

cues.en: I should have never underestimated him.

cues.zh: 他把我逼入了一个无法取胜的局面
cues.en: he's put me in an unwinnable scenario

cues.zh: 让我的理智本身岌岌可危。
cues.en: that puts my very humanity at stake.

cues.zh: 如果我顺从本心，看向我忠实的妻子，
cues.en: If I follow my heart and look at my faithful wife,
therefore beholding the symbol of death,

cues.zh: 我就会把良知从精神堡垒中引开
cues.en: I'll be luring my conscience away from the mental fortress

cues.zh: 那是我苦心建起的堡垒。
cues.en: I’ve worked so hard to build.
But I'm afraid that by not looking,

cues.zh: 反而会砌上砖墙的最后一块石头
cues.en: it will lay the final stone in the brick wall

cues.zh: 我的心智和灵魂将变得坚不可摧！
cues.en: And my mind and heart will become impenetrable!

cues.zh: 我将再也无法让任何人走进我的内心！
cues.en: I won't be able to let anyone in ever again!

cues.zh: 我将失去最后一丝人性。
cues.en: I will lose my last shred of humanity.

cues.zh: 你的攻击对我毫无作用，野蛮人。
cues.en: Your attacks will have no effect on me, Barbarian.

cues.zh: 我的本能依然锐利如刃。

cues.en: (Gotoh) But your wife. You must look.

cues.zh: （Philip）我了解你的信仰和你誓守的戒律。
cues.en: (Philip) I know your faith and the discipline you swear by.

cues.zh: 只要我不看，你就无法碰我一根手指。
cues.en: You cannot lay a finger upon me if I do not look.

cues.zh: 而我的心智比你的诱惑更强大。
cues.en: And my faculties are stronger than your lure.
For you are powerless against me.

cues.zh: 戴上眼罩，制服这个入侵者！
cues.en: Put on your blindfolds and restrain this intruder!

cues.zh: 我要他的双手被铁链锁住，永不见天日。
cues.en: I want his hands covered in iron, never to be seen again.

cues.zh: 是啊，我们想来场大战斗
cues.en: Aye, well we wanna have a big battle
but we don't have enough troops!

cues.zh: 如果我们招到足够的兵，
cues.en: And if we get enough troops,
